pattern.short_summary: Every system-produced item arrives with the same small, closed set of actions attached to it, so the user's response to any suggestion is drawn from a uniform vocabulary.
pattern.definition: Every system-produced item arrives with the same small, closed set of actions attached to it, so the user's response to any suggestion is drawn from a uniform vocabulary. The unit of disposition is the individual item, not the batch. The specific set varies by system — accept/regenerate/edit, replace/abstract, insert/ignore — but its fixity and its per-item attachment are what the pattern names.
pattern.structural_signature: Each generated item is rendered with a co-located control group whose members are identical across items and constant across the session; activating a member commits a disposition for that item alone and leaves other items untouched. The set is enumerable and closed, and there is no path for disposing of items that is not in the set.

dimension.category_description: How users inspect, modify, scope, revise, accept, program, or interrupt generated work at the artifact level.
dimension.classification_boundary: Centers user control during or after generation, including editable intermediate generators and representations.
